item_reviews.comment: Model M-110M beats the best baseline on every T1 metric, and S1 gives † markers on all five.
Both 40M and 42M exceed every baseline on all five T1 metrics. Margins for 40M are small, and no significance is reported for them.
e5 leads on all four T2 metrics. Recall@200 is 0.911 vs 0.910 for the 110M model.
The T2 note says no significance markers. P1 and the T2 caption say judgments are incomplete and recall is unreliable.
The package states no seeds or variance are reported. S1 lacks exact p-values, test statistic, n and sidedness.

missing_core_findings.description: On 2AIRTC, Model M's transfer is mixed. Model M-110M beats gte-multilingual-base and ties or trails snowflake and e5 closely on recall. Model M-40M is clearly weaker, so transfer depends on model size. gte-modernbert-base fails on both datasets.
